parameters.query: SELECT c.claim_number, d.id AS denial_id, d.denied_amount, p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS patient_name, u.email AS owner_email, u.first_name AS owner_name FROM denials d JOIN claims c ON d.claim_id = c.id JOIN patients p ON c.patient_id = p.id JOIN users u ON d.assigned_to = u.id WHERE d.status IN ('New', 'Reviewing') AND d.denial_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '83 days';
